images.name: Ubuntu Desktop (LTS)
images.notes: SHA256SUMS covers the payload tree only — EFI/, .disk/ and boot/grub/ (the boot chain) are absent from it, so a manifest match alone does not confirm the stick can boot.

images.name: Ubuntu Server (LTS)
images.notes: SHA256SUMS covers the payload tree only — EFI/, .disk/ and boot/grub/ (the boot chain) are absent from it, so a manifest match alone does not confirm the stick can boot.

images.name: Fedora Workstation
images.notes: Fedora's CHECKSUM file is GPG-clearsigned inline, not a detached signature — fetch_verified's separate sig_url model does not apply directly. sha256 comparison only for now.

images.name: SystemRescue
images.notes: index deliberately points at the vendor CDN, not SourceForge: system-rescue's own SourceForge /download link is an HTML mirror-chooser interstitial, not the ISO (finding A7).

images.name: Proxmox VE
images.notes: writeMode is raw: this is a disk image, not a hybrid ISO. It must be written block-for-block (dd / Rufus DD mode) and must never be offered to a Ventoy copy path (finding A11).

images.name: GParted Live
images.notes: SourceForge-hosted like system-rescue was (finding A7) — the /download shortcut can return an HTML mirror page instead of the file. Not yet confirmed against a direct CDN; verify before wiring the downloader to this entry.

images.name: Clonezilla Live
images.notes: SourceForge-hosted like system-rescue was (finding A7); same caveat as gparted-live — verify the direct file path before wiring the downloader to this entry.

images.name: Memtest86+
images.notes: GitHub Releases asset naming and the sha256sum.txt asset name are best-effort from the project's recent releases, not pinned — confirm both against the current release before wiring the downloader to this entry.

images.name: Custom URL
images.notes: UI affordance, not a downloadable image: becomes a free-text URL field. The user supplies the URL, kind and writeMode; nothing here is resolved from this catalog.

images.name: Custom local file
images.notes: UI affordance, not a downloadable image: becomes a free-text local file-path field for an image the user already has on disk. Nothing here is resolved from this catalog.
